description.text: Ten single attacks (0.71 each), causes [Imperil Ice 20%] for 25 seconds, grants [Ice Radiant Shield: 75%] to all allies, grants [Attach Ice] and [Quick Cast 3] to the user

description.name: Ice Radiant Shield: 75%

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%
